author: DevTemWPF
name: DevTemWPF ViewModel Unit Test
description: Adds a behavioral unit test scaffold that exercises ViewModel commands and state following project conventions. Use the same name as the ViewModel plus a Tests suffix (e.g. -n EditorViewModelTests).

RootNamespace.description: Root namespace of the generated app (the .App and .Unit suffixes are preserved).

TargetViewModelName.description: ViewModel type under test, derived from the item name minus the Tests suffix.
